Air Commerce Act of 1926 (44 Stat. 570), 
the airspace above the three following- 
described portions of the United States 
is hereby reserved and set apart for na­
tional defense arid other governmental 
purposes as airspace reservations within 
which no person shall navigate an air­
craft except by authority of the United 
States Atomic Energy Commission.

lying within each of the following-de­
scribed boundaries:
